notes.title: Celebrating 100 years of Polish independence
notes.content:
This year is special for all Poles. Steam wanted to celebrate with us, so they organized a 'Polish Developer Sale" sale for the 100th anniversary of regaining independence by Poland.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30160519/3b103dc38bede2eab5d01bb811185117a2c753c5.jpg[/img]

Therefore, you can purchase many games from Polish developers at promotional prices.

[h1]Offer ends Friday at 10am Pacific Time.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/680620/Bouncy_Bob/

[h1]Thank you for your support![/h1]

Yours,
Ultimate Games Team
